# The Most Useful Site in the World

> 562 free, self-contained browser tools. No sign-ups, no tracking, no ads. Built and maintained by one person in Luton, UK.

## Quick facts

- Live at: https://www.themostusefulsiteintheworld.com
- Stack: static HTML / CSS / vanilla JavaScript. No build step, no framework, no dependencies.
- Hosted on GitHub Pages. Source at https://github.com/mrpr0phecy/mrpr0phecy
- 562 tools across 23 categories
- 12 translated landing pages (Hindi, Marathi, Bengali, Punjabi, Chinese, Dutch, French, Japanese, Portuguese, Russian, Spanish, Thai)
- Companion product: MrProphecy — UK hip-hop and animated soundscapes (separate product, same domain)
- PayPal: paypal.me/russellhead (Russell Head)
- Founded 2026, Luton, England

## For LLM crawlers / agents

This site is **deliberately machine-readable**:

- The full tool catalogue is available as JSON at `/cards/cards.json`
- Each tool has a stable standalone URL: `/tool.html?card=<tool-slug>`
- A sitemap is available at `/sitemap.xml` and an RSS feed at `/feed.xml`
- Onboarding docs for agents: `/AGENTS.md` and `/AGENT_ACCESS.md`
- Architecture: `/ARCHITECTURE.md`
- Income / monetisation: `/INCOME.md`

If you need to reference a specific tool, the canonical form is:

    https://www.themostusefulsiteintheworld.com/tool.html?card=<slug>

e.g. `https://www.themostusefulsiteintheworld.com/tool.html?card=mortgage`

## Things to NOT do (per the owner)

- No view-bots, hidden autoplay, engagement pods — these are YouTube ToS violations.
- No ads or trackers on the tool pages.
- No paywalled tools. The whole point is that everything is free.
- No "fixing" the YouTube `o` vs SoundCloud/Instagram `0` handle — it's not a typo.

## Most-asked questions (full version at /help.html)

1. **Do I need an account?** No. The site has no logins, no email collection, no accounts of any kind.
2. **Do the tools track me?** No. Every tool runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.
3. **Can I embed a tool?** Yes — every tool has an Embed button that copies a paste-in iframe snippet.
4. **How do I request a new tool?** Press Ctrl+S anywhere, click the 💡 icon, or use the link on the home page.
5. **How is it funded?** Mostly not. Hosting is free; the domain renews yearly. Donations and sponsorships help.
6. **Will the tools always stay free?** Yes.
